original_idea.body:
# Runtime Injection Detection Benchmark: RIDB

**Problem:** No benchmark exists for evaluating the effectiveness of runtime prompt injection detectors. Research groups cannot compare their defenses.

**Direction:** Compile 200 agent context windows: 100 clean, 100 containing injected adversarial instructions of five types. Package as a benchmark with evaluation metrics (AUROC, F1, false-positive rate). Baseline three simple detectors (keyword, regex, embedding similarity).

**Why it matters:** A standardized benchmark would accelerate research on injection detection by enabling direct comparison. It also reveals which simple baselines are already adequate.

**Relevant context:** Jiang et al. 2026; indirect prompt injection literature; standard ML benchmark design.
